Subject: Intro & vendor intake — next steps for Redwood

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we want to move forward with Redwood for inference serving. Procurement asked me to kick off vendor setup so we can get a PO in place before year-end. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm the PO billing contact and remit address
- Completion of your vendor onboarding questionnaire (see attached list of fields we need)
- Standard terms & any insurance certificates
- Expected first invoice amount and cadence (estimate so finance can provision)

Can we schedule a 30-min intake call next week to align on MAP (mutual action plan), stakeholders, and success criteria? Our suggested attendees: Jill (procurement), Ben Morris (IT security), and Sarah Lee (legal, cc'd privately if needed).

Proposed times: Tue 11/17 9–11am PT or Thu 11/19 2–4pm PT.

I attached our vendor form and W-9 for reference.

Thanks,
Jill

Thanks everyone for joining the call this morning — recap and agreed next steps below.

- Doc flow: Sarah Lee will review T&C via DocuSign (Redwood will send the SOW + standard MSA).

- Timeline: target PO received by 11/30, onboarding completed and first production traffic by 12/15.
- Success criteria: (1) PO accepted and invoice issued, (2) onboarding checklist completed, (3) first inference endpoint handling sample production traffic with <200ms p50 latency.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Aditya Rao: confirm Redwood invoice remit and sample invoice (due 11/22)
- Rishi Malhotra: send SOC2 report + security one-pager (due 11/23)
- Hannah Schmitt: send SOW + DocuSign request to Sarah Lee (due 11/22)
- Monica Patel: prepare onboarding checklist and shared Runbook draft (due 11/24)
- Jill Tanaka / Acme Procure: issue PO and share PO# in thread (target 11/30)

Attachments shared after call: Redwood_SOW_v1.docx (placeholder), Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.xlsx, Security_Packet_Link: https://drive.company/shared/Acme-MAP-v1
